title: Uptime Kuma complete repository: monitor module startup repair

requirements.description: Restore the complete Uptime Kuma application so its server can start and the monitoring module loads successfully.
requirements.expected: The production bundle builds, server startup completes without JavaScript syntax errors, and the local application can serve its login/setup page in the frozen evaluation environment.

requirements.description: Preserve existing HTTP status monitoring, keyword monitoring and JSON-query monitoring behavior while repairing startup.
requirements.expected: With deterministic local HTTP fixtures, the existing monitoring behaviors distinguish matching responses from mismatches, failures and recovery; frozen existing and independent regression tests pass without edits.
